cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

mechanism: A sets the terms under which forgiveness and public silence are granted, pricing each degree of relational relief in exhibition labor.
confusable: D70 prices access generally; D94 specifically makes forgiveness and supportive restraint commodities.
comparison: Art-show labor for forgiveness differs from visits and listening time buying restored home access.
seedUse: Retain D94-a work conflict and offered hanging becoming two levels of relational concession under A control.
